custom_expected: Permission summary matches documented target. Spec-documented intentional changes (gains or losses vs legacy) are expected. User can perform the documented workflows; if any spec-documented capability is missing or any non-spec capability is present, file as bug.
custom_preconds: Migration complete. Legacy Service Manager user exists.
custom_steps:
1. Go to left sidebar > SETTINGS > Staff. Locate a legacy Service Manager user. Confirm role = 'Service Manager'.
2. Go to Roles & Permissions, find 'Service Manager' row. Click eye icon for permission summary.
3. Compare against documented Service Manager target on legacy mapping page (id=565116931).
4. Identify any spec-documented intentional difference vs legacy.
5. Log in as this user and spot-check 3-5 key workflows (e.g., approve WO, manage technicians, view AP/AR).
title: Legacy 'Service Manager' users land on system 'Service Manager' role with documented target permissions
